body.name: Cross-fitted boundary local-linear one-step estimator
body.construction: Partition \([0,1]\) into bins of width \(b_n\asymp(\log n/n)^{1/(5+\kappa_+)}\). On each training fold, estimate \(g\) from \(\sum X_iB_iB_i^{\mathsf T}\widehat\theta=\sum B_iA_i\), estimate \(\mu_1\) and \(\mu_0\) by treatment-weighted local linear least squares, clip to the primitive bounds, and set \(\widehat e(x)=x\widehat g(x)\). For held-out unit \(i\), write \(\widehat D_i=1+(\delta_n-1)\widehat e_i\) and define the uncentered fitted score \(\widehat\varphi_{\delta_n,i}=A_i\delta_n\{Y_i-\widehat\mu_{1,i}\}/\widehat D_i+(1-A_i)\{Y_i-\widehat\mu_{0,i}\}/\widehat D_i+\delta_n(\widehat\mu_{1,i}-\widehat\mu_{0,i})(A_i-\widehat e_i)/\widehat D_i^2+\widehat\mu_{0,i}+\delta_n\widehat e_i(\widehat\mu_{1,i}-\widehat\mu_{0,i})/\widehat D_i\), where every fitted value comes from the training fold excluding \(i\). Set \(\widehat\psi_{\delta_n}=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n\widehat\varphi_{\delta_n,i}\).
